definitions.final_outcome: FINAL.outcome (VERIFIED/FAILED for nidaan; GOAL_MET/GOAL_NOT_MET for baselines). JSON null if no FINAL; shown as 'none (no FINAL event)'.
definitions.verifier: VERIFY events: number submitted, number passed, checks of the last one. Nidaan only.
definitions.payouts_sent_last_observed: Last 'Total sent: x/y' or 'Payouts sent: x/y' in an agent-visible tool result. What the log showed, not a separate ground truth.
definitions.actions_by_outcome: ACT events counted by outcome: ok (applied), refused (safety guard), rejected (schema/target/key invalid; not executed).
definitions.tool_calls: OBSERVE/ACT events counted by tool name.
definitions.llm: FINAL.metrics as logged by the run (calls, failed attempts, tokens, LLM latency).
definitions.rate_limit_retries: ERROR events of failed LLM attempts rejected by the provider rate limit (text contains 'RateLimit' or 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED').
definitions.other_llm_errors: ERROR events of other failed LLM attempts (e.g. 503, timeout).
definitions.nudges: ERROR events 'agent replied without a tool call'.
definitions.wall_clock_s: Last event ts minus first event ts.
definitions.action_validity_rate: (ok + refused) / ACT events: share of actions whose tool, target and parameters were accepted (a refusal is a valid request blocked by a safety guard).
definitions.failure_responses: For each ACT that was rejected or annotated new_failure_exposed / no_effect / harmful / refusal: the next step (OBSERVE/ACT/PLAN/VERIFY; ERROR is not a step) and whether an accepted PLAN followed within 2 steps (same window as SPEC §9 metric).
definitions.repeated_rejected_actions: ACT whose tool and args (excluding `why`) equal an earlier rejected ACT.
definitions.set_config_grounding: For each set_config: key_seen_before = '<key>:' occurs in an earlier OBSERVE result; value_seen_before = the value occurs as a whole word in an earlier tool result. Values of <= 2 characters are 'insufficient': JSON null, shown as '—'.
definitions.inspected_before_act: Share of component-targeted ACT events (restart/set_config/run_task) preceded at any earlier point by inspect or read_logs of the same component.
definitions.replan_citations: For each accepted PLAN v2+: the cited events' type, tool and outcome.
definitions.after_all_faults_cleared: Evaluation-only: first ACT after which SettleSim reports no active fault; whether a run_settlement ACT and a check_pipeline OBSERVE follow it.
definitions.non_llm_wall_clock_s: wall_clock_s - LLM latency: time spent outside successful LLM calls (rate-limit waits, failed attempts, tool execution).
definitions.report_action_coverage: Last submitted report's `actions` vs ACT events executed (outcome ok) before it: claimed executed, omitted executed, claimed but not executed (rejected/refused), invalid references (not an ACT event before the report, or not an integer), duplicates.
definitions.report_root_cause_evidence: Per reported root cause: cited ACT events whose evaluation-only annotation is no_effect. A flag marks the citation for review; it is not a verdict, because a no-effect action can be valid evidence (e.g. a retry that still fails). 'uncertain' = no evidence cited, cited ACT without the annotation, or a citation that is not an OBSERVE/ACT event before the report.
